name: USGS National Archive of Marine Seismic Surveys (NAMSS)
license: Public domain ("no restrictions on usage or publication"); DataCite lists CC0 1.0 for the DOI
attribution: Triezenberg, P.J., Hart, P.E., and Childs, J.R., 2016, National Archive of Marine Seismic Surveys (NAMSS), U.S. Geological Survey data release, https://doi.org/10.5066/F7930R7P
how_to_get: direct HTTPS zip per survey, no login
notes: Released after the 25-year proprietary term of the BOEM permit.

name: SARIG, South Australian Resources Information Gateway
provider: Department for Energy and Mining, Government of South Australia
data: 3D seismic packages (SEG-Y in zip), wells, 2D seismic
license: CC BY 4.0 (CKAN license_id; the disclaimer file inside each zip says CC BY 3.0 AU)
attribution: Department for Energy and Mining, Government of South Australia (SARIG); keep the disclaimer file with redistributed copies
how_to_get: direct HTTPS (Azure blob) links from the CKAN catalog, no login
counts: 167 3D volumes in 162 surveys in this index; 32,332 CKAN records

name: BOEM Data Center: well, velocity, paleo, sands atlas and field tables (Gulf of America)
data: well headers and paths, check-shots, paleo tops, pay sands, reserves
license: Public information: "may be distributed or copied" (no named license)
attribution: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, data.boem.gov
how_to_get: direct HTTPS zips, no login; tables are refreshed often
counts: 55,570 Gulf boreholes; 13,434 atlas sands in 1,336 fields
notes: Checksums change when BOEM refreshes a table.

name: BOEM/BSEE File Request System: well logs and well files
provider: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management and Bureau of Safety and Environmental Enforcement
data: digital well logs (LAS, DLIS, LIS), log images (TIFF), well files
license: Public information (same BOEM terms); release schedule NTL 2014-G03
attribution: Bureau of Ocean Energy Management, File Request System
how_to_get: Login.gov account; upload a list of file IDs; BOEM emails a link within 24 h, live 5 days; 25 GB per request. Use: osd frs plan
counts: 15,578 digital log files for 4,260 wells in the public inventory (18 Oct 2026)
size: 462 GB of digital logs in the inventory

name: NETL Energy Data eXchange (EDX): Gulf log and saline storage data sets
provider: US DOE National Energy Technology Laboratory
data: SP and GR logs (LAS), interpreted log picks
license: "No License Restrictions" (LAS set); Open Data Commons Attribution (saline storage set)
attribution: Meckel and Trevino (LAS files Texas and Louisiana); Bean et al. 2020 (Offshore CO2 Saline Storage Assessment Dataset)
counts: 142 wells with logs; 646 wells with picks

name: LDEO Borehole Research Group LogDB: scientific ocean drilling logs
data: LWD and wireline logs from DSDP, ODP and IODP holes on Zenodo (one record per hole), plus Gulf of Mexico files from the LogDB site (IODP Exp. 308, Gas Hydrate JIP Legs I and II, DSDP Legs 1 and 96)
license: CC0 1.0 on the Zenodo records; no license stated for the JIP and DSDP files on the LogDB site
redistribution: Zenodo records: allowed (CC0); JIP files on the LogDB site: not stated, ask LDEO
how_to_get: direct HTTPS from Zenodo and the LogDB site, no login
counts: 712 holes on Zenodo (1,424 files); 27 Gulf holes from the LogDB site (28 files)
size: 196 GB on Zenodo; about 20 MB from the LogDB site
notes: The hole pages on the LogDB site link to the Zenodo records. The 16 DSDP and IODP Gulf holes from the site are also on Zenodo; the 11 JIP holes are only on the site. Each Zenodo record has its own DOI (10.5281/zenodo.<record id>, the number in file_id)

name: NLOG, Dutch oil and gas portal
provider: TNO Geological Survey of the Netherlands
fees: free online; EUR 600 per post-stack 3D survey not online
license: NLOG disclaimer: copy, download, distribute and edit without permission, quoting NLOG.NL as the source
how_to_get: map viewer or datacenter download, no login; data released after 5 years (Mijnbouwbesluit art. 116)
counts: 341 3D surveys, 324 with SEG-Y online; 6,738 boreholes (our API counts)
notes: Per-file index planned for a later version.

name: NOPIMS, National Offshore Petroleum Information Management System
fees: free download; partial cost recovery for media (GA price schedule)
license: CC BY 4.0 for all open-file data (GA price schedule v2.5, 2019)
how_to_get: direct links per item (CloudFront); OData metadata feed
counts: 428 3D survey records, 234 with downloadable processed items; 8,916 wells and boreholes
notes: The file host refuses the default curl and python User-Agent strings (HTTP 403). Per-file index planned.

name: WAPIMS, Western Australian Petroleum and Geothermal Information Management System
provider: Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration, Western Australia
license: CC BY 4.0 per the license section; a second non-commercial text on the same page
redistribution: allowed with attribution under CC BY 4.0 (see note)
attribution: State of Western Australia (Department of Mines, Petroleum and Exploration)
how_to_get: download per item from survey pages, no login
counts: 234 3D survey records, 75 with downloadable stacks; 4,314 wells (our counts)
notes: Two license texts on one page; ask the department which applies.

name: GEUS Danish deep subsurface data
provider: Geological Survey of Denmark and Greenland
fees: none for the free data sets
license: GEUS terms (2023-09-19): GEUS keeps all rights; own use, processing and sale of derived products allowed; passing data on only free of charge in specific cases
how_to_get: accept the terms of delivery in the map portal, then download
notes: Not open: a terms click-through, and no open license.

name: UK National Data Repository (NDR)
fees: 3 TB per organization per month free (academics share one 3 TB quota); more at GBP 93 per TB per month
license: NDR User Agreement (2023-07-01): non-transferable right to download and use
attribution: Contains information provided by the North Sea Transition Authority and/or other third parties.
how_to_get: register through an organization (academics share the UK Academia account), accept the agreement
counts: 716 post-stack 3D data sets over 384 surveys (NSTA open layers)
notes: Listed for comparison; the terms do not allow redistribution.

name: Diskos, the Norwegian national data repository
provider: Diskos joint venture with the Norwegian Offshore Directorate (Sodir)
fees: oil companies about NOK 850,000 a year; associated members about NOK 190,000 a year, 3-year minimum; universities free with an unstated yearly download volume; upload and download fees on top; prices sent to members only
license: no open license found; Sodir: "Ownership of data will not change even if the data is released"
how_to_get: members download; non-members need a registered account to order well and seismic data through the Diskos portal
counts: 1,027 3D surveys reported to Sodir (FactMaps); more than 24,000 public post-stack cubes (Ordonez et al. 2026)
size: more than 22 PB as of 1 Jan 2026 (Sodir)
notes: Listed for comparison only; nothing from Diskos is in this index.

name: LILY database: lithology linked to IODP physical, chemical and magnetic properties
data: core measurements from the JOIDES Resolution (GRA density, magnetic susceptibility, NGR, P-wave velocity, color, moisture and density, carbonate, chemistry, paleomagnetism, thermal conductivity), each joined to the described lithology; 541 holes from expeditions 318 to 379
license: not stated in the Zenodo record metadata (checked 2026-10-22)
attribution: Childress, L.B., Acton, G.D., Percuoco, V.P. and Hastedt, M. (2024), The LILY Database: Linking Lithology to IODP Physical, Chemical, and Magnetic Properties Data, G-cubed; data DOI 10.5281/zenodo.8408297
how_to_get: direct HTTPS from Zenodo, no login
notes: Hole positions are not in the data files; data/cores/lily_holes.csv takes them from LILY 2_CoreSUMM.zip

name: International Ocean Discovery Program community on Zenodo
provider: JOIDES Resolution Science Operator (Texas A&M University) and IODP
data: IODP expedition data from the JOIDES Resolution (core and section images, physical properties, chemistry, paleomagnetism, core descriptions, sample reports, navigation and more), ODP and DSDP Proceedings and Initial Reports volumes, ODP technical notes and manuals, and data from papers
license: per record, as Zenodo states it: CC BY 4.0 (most records), CC0 1.0, CC BY-SA 4.0 (one record), not stated (one record); files.csv gives it per file
redistribution: as each record states: CC BY 4.0, CC0 1.0 or CC BY-SA 4.0; one record states no license
attribution: International Ocean Discovery Program, with each record's own citation and DOI
how_to_get: direct HTTPS from Zenodo, no login
notes: Each record has its own DOI (10.5281/zenodo.<record id>, the number in file_id). The community holds 3,418 records: LILY is indexed under lily and one restricted record is left out. JRSO lists the expedition records at https://iodp.tamu.edu/database/zenodo.html
